patches_modified.name: Remove unused language packs
patches_modified.description: Removes the app languages you don't list in this patch's options, saving up to about 26 MB of storage. English is always kept. With no list it keeps them all. Only patching again brings removed ones back.

patches_modified.name: Remove voice tools
patches_modified.description: Removes TikTok's speech recognition files, saving about 16 MB of storage. The catch: voice search, naming a song by listening, talking to TikTok's AI assistant and TikTok's music check on videos you post all stop working. Only patching again without it brings them back.

patches_modified.name: Report a newer phone to effects
patches_modified.description: Tells TikTok's effects server you have a newer phone, so effects it turns down on older phones get another chance. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Repost diagnostics
patches_modified.description: With diagnostic logging on, notes when you repost a video and what TikTok answered, to help track down reposts that don't stick. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Resource and battery governor
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok reading your phone's motion sensors, which it can use to identify your phone, and stops a background speed test that can use a lot of memory. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Resume videos after scrolling
patches_modified.description: When you scroll back to a video, it picks up where you left off instead of starting over. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Run beside the store app
patches_modified.description: Lets a renamed copy of TikTok, made with Morphe's Clone app patch, sign in while the regular TikTok stays installed. Pick it together with Clone app. Google and Facebook sign-in won't work in the copy, so use email or phone.

patches_modified.name: SIM spoof
patches_modified.description: Makes TikTok see the SIM country and carrier you choose. It may not change your region, since TikTok also goes by your internet connection and account. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Region.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Removes the tracking codes from TikTok links you share, so the link carries less about you. It can also swap tiktok.com for another site. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Settings
patches_modified.description: Adds the Hushfeed settings page to TikTok, at the top of Settings and privacy. Pressing and holding For You at the top of the feed opens it too. That's where you turn Hushfeed's features on and off. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Share sheet tools
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide people, apps and buttons you don't use from the share sheet, add apps you do use, and copy a video's link with one press on Share. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Share sheet.

patches_modified.name: Show LIVE search
patches_modified.description: Adds TikTok's search button inside the LIVE section where TikTok supports it, so you can look for LIVEs. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Show author region
patches_modified.description: Shows the country a video was posted from next to the creator's name. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Show commenter handle and region
patches_modified.description: Shows a commenter's @username in place of their display name and the country their account is set to after the comment's time. It can also give each commenter's name a color of its own. Each starts off. Turn them on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Show engagement rate
patches_modified.description: Shows how many people liked, commented on, shared or saved a video compared with how many watched it, next to the creator's name. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Show exact counts
patches_modified.description: Shows likes, comments and other counts as full numbers, like 1,234,567 instead of 1.2M. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Show follow status
patches_modified.description: Shows on a profile whether that person follows you back, and marks accounts in your follow lists that don't. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App. A separate switch adds the month an account was made. Optional local counts and appearance controls apply to your own profile.

patches_modified.name: Show the progress bar
patches_modified.description: Shows the progress bar on videos where TikTok hides it, so you can see how long a video is and skip around. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback, where you can also show the time beside the bar or give it a bigger handle. Seek bars for video stories and sound previews are there too.

patches_modified.name: Show the progress bar thumbnail
patches_modified.description: Shows a small preview picture while you drag the progress bar, so you can find the part you want. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Skip content warnings
patches_modified.description: Plays videos without the warning screen you'd have to tap through first, and can hide the Check sources and Check your sources banners. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Skip first-launch setup
patches_modified.description: Skips TikTok's setup screens on a fresh install, like the interest picker and the swipe tutorial. Sign-in and age screens still show. Its switch is on once picked, since setup runs before you can reach settings. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Skip passkey sign-in
patches_modified.description: Lets you sign in another way, like your password or a code by email or text, when TikTok wants a passkey. Password managers won't hand a passkey to a patched app, so that step can't finish here. With the switch on, TikTok treats your phone as one without passkeys. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Skip the splash ad
patches_modified.description: Lets you stop the full-screen ad TikTok can show while it starts up. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Skip update checks
patches_modified.description: Lets you stop two background tasks TikTok uses to check for updates, one of them when your phone starts. Some in-app update prompts may stop. Play Store updates still work. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Stay on the video in full screen
patches_modified.description: When a video ends in TikTok's full screen view, it stays on that video instead of moving to the next one. Swiping still moves on. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Stop on-device AI profiling
patches_modified.description: Lets you stop TikTok's built-in AI engine from starting, so it doesn't get a copy of everything TikTok logs about your use. TikTok works as if the engine weren't there. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Stop recording watch history
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok adding the videos you watch to your Watch history. The catch: your views stop counting, and For You learns less about what you like. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Stop saving search history
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok saving your new searches on your phone. Older searches stay until you delete them, and TikTok's servers may keep their own record. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Stop search autoplay
patches_modified.description: Stops videos in search results from playing by themselves. Each one shows its cover until you open it, so searching stays quiet. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Stop video looping
patches_modified.description: Stops a video at its end instead of playing it again. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Story controls
patches_modified.description: Lets a story replay when it ends instead of moving on, and keeps a photo story on screen until you tap or swipe. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Subtitle tools
patches_modified.description: Lets you make captions bigger, change their background and keep them in clear display, bring back TikTok's captions switch where it's missing, and save subtitle files with downloaded videos. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen, and Downloads for subtitle files.

patches_modified.name: Swipe-left controls
patches_modified.description: Lets a left swipe on a video open its comments or do nothing, instead of opening the creator's profile. Starts off. Pick an action in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Translate comments
patches_modified.description: Translates comments as they load, using TikTok's own translator, so you don't have to tap Translate on each one. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments, where more rows list languages TikTok's automatic translation should leave alone, keep videos in the language they were made in, pick the language translations come out in, and add TikTok's translate button beside the comment count.

patches_modified.name: Trust user certificates
patches_modified.description: Lets TikTok trust security certificates you install yourself, so a tool like mitmproxy can show what the app sends. The risk: anyone who gets a certificate onto your phone can read TikTok's traffic too. Use it only on a test phone.

patches_modified.name: Turn off haptics
patches_modified.description: Stops the little vibrations TikTok makes when you tap or hold things. Your keyboard and your phone's own vibrations stay. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Turn off screen transitions
patches_modified.description: Opens and closes TikTok's screens without the sliding animation, so moving around feels quicker. Swipes still follow your finger. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Use non-personalized search
patches_modified.description: Shows search results that aren't tailored to your account. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Use system font
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's text in your phone's own font or in a .ttf or .otf font file you import, instead of TikTok's, and can use your phone's emoji too. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.

patches_added.name: Unlock native engine
patches_added.description: Patches the native engine library (libd.so) so that it loads on a re-signed APK. The anti-tamper constructor that destroys a global mutex is disabled, and the trap instructions the verification routine plants inside its own code - udf #0 (SIGILL) and stores of the markers 0xdead and 0xdeadbeef (SIGSEGV) - are replaced by no-ops, leaving the routine's work intact. This is what makes Web Widget Overlay and button emulation work.

patches_modified.name: Unlock premium
patches_modified.description: Makes the bundled Google LVL policy always report the app as licensed, which unlocks the premium features.
patches_modified.previous_description: Makes the bundled Google LVL policy always report the app as licensed, and bypasses the native engine: it drops the System.loadLibrary("d") call whose library aborts the process on a re-signed APK, and stubs the methods that library provided so the app cannot die with UnsatisfiedLinkError. Features that need the engine stay unavailable.

patches_added.name: Skip ads (v17)
patches_added.description: Removes Pluto TV's on-demand (VOD) ads on the v17.x rebuild (the Paramount+/AVIA player stack). Four layers: (1+2) force AVIA's DAI and IMA shouldPlayAd() gates to false so the pre-roll ad pods are skipped natively; (3) drop the ad <Period>s from the stitched multi-period DASH manifest at AVIA's own DashParser and re-base the content periods into a contiguous timeline, so the mid-roll ad VIDEO is never played AND the seekbar tracks correctly; (4) suppress the ID3/CLID3-driven CSAI ad call on static VOD manifests. Also hides pause ads and stops ad impression beacons for the removed breaks. Fail-open: a manifest it can't rewrite is passed through unchanged (ads remain, playback never breaks). LIVE TV ads are real broadcast time in the linear feed and are not removable. Validated on-device, 17.2.0.

patches_modified.name: Skip ads
patches_modified.description: Removes Pluto TV's on-demand (VOD) ads entirely — ad video, markers, overlays, and beacons. Two layers: (1) drops the ad <Period>s from the stitched DASH manifest at media3's parser and re-bases the content periods contiguous, so the ad VIDEO is never played (verified on-device: 2:49:58 -> 2:18:41, mid-rolls gone); (2) empties the client-side ad-break timeline (StitcherSession.adBreaks — the same data AdGuard strips via jsonprune) and no-ops pause ads and clickable-ad overlays, removing the markers/UI/beacons. Fail-open: a manifest it can't rewrite is passed through unchanged (ads remain, playback never breaks). A resume bookmark saved in the original (ad-inclusive) timeline is re-mapped into the shortened timeline so resuming a partially-watched episode no longer overshoots the end and autoplay-skips (issue #147). LIVE TV ads are real broadcast time in the linear feed and are not removable. Validated on-device, 5.66.0-leanback.

Two layers: (1) drops the ad <Period>s from the stitched DASH manifest at media3's parser and re-bases the content periods contiguous, so the ad VIDEO is never played (verified on-device: 2:49:58 -> 2:18:41, mid-rolls gone); (2) empties the client-side ad-break timeline (StitcherSession.adBreaks — the same data AdGuard strips via jsonprune) and no-ops pause ads and clickable-ad overlays, removing the markers/UI/beacons. Fail-open: a manifest it can't rewrite is passed through unchanged (ads remain, playback never breaks). A resume bookmark saved in the original (ad-inclusive) timeline is re-mapped into the shortened timeline so resuming a partially-watched episode no longer overshoots the end and autoplay-skips (issue #147). LIVE TV ads are real broadcast time in the linear feed and are not removable. Validated on-device, 5.66.0-leanback.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes Pluto TV's on-demand (VOD) ads on the v17.x rebuild (the Paramount+/AVIA player stack). Four layers: (1+2) force AVIA's DAI and IMA shouldPlayAd() gates to false so the pre-roll ad pods are skipped natively; (3) drop the ad <Period>s from the stitched multi-period DASH manifest at AVIA's own DashParser and re-base the content periods into a contiguous timeline, so the mid-roll ad VIDEO is never played AND the seekbar tracks correctly; (4) suppress the ID3/CLID3-driven CSAI ad call on static VOD manifests. Fail-open: a manifest it can't rewrite is passed through unchanged (ads remain, playback never breaks). LIVE TV ads are real broadcast time in the linear feed and are not removable. Validated on-device, 17.2.0.

patches_modified.previous_description: Keeps the video playing in a small window when you leave TikTok, so you can keep watching while you use other apps. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_modified.name: Play SDR instead of HDR
patches_modified.description: Plays the normal version of HDR videos, so your screen doesn't suddenly jump to full brightness. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > App behavior.
patches_modified.previous_description: Plays the normal version of HDR videos, so your screen doesn't suddenly jump to full brightness. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_modified.name: Playback quality
patches_modified.description: Lets you choose the video quality, like highest, lowest or 720p, and set a lower quality for mobile data to use less data. Starts off. Pick a quality in the patch settings > App behavior.
patches_modified.previous_description: Lets you choose the video quality, like highest, lowest or 720p, and set a lower quality for mobile data to use less data. Starts off. Pick a quality in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_modified.name: Playback speed
patches_modified.description: Remembers the speed you picked for the next video, and lets you set a default speed, add speeds up to 3x to the menu and choose the speed for press and hold. On by default. Turn it off in the patch settings > App behavior.
patches_modified.previous_description: Remembers the speed you picked for the next video, and lets you set a default speed, add speeds up to 3x to the menu and choose the speed for press and hold. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_modified.name: Prefer H.264 playback
patches_modified.description: Plays videos in an older format your phone decodes more easily, which can help older phones play smoothly and run cooler. Videos without it play as before. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > App behavior.
patches_modified.previous_description: Plays videos in an older format your phone decodes more easily, which can help older phones play smoothly and run cooler. Videos without it play as before. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_modified.name: Profile background
patches_modified.description: Opens TikTok's own profile background editor in Edit profile on accounts TikTok hasn't offered it to yet, and shows the backgrounds other profiles have set. TikTok's servers may still refuse to save one for such an account. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > App behavior.
patches_modified.previous_description: Opens TikTok's own profile background editor in Edit profile on accounts TikTok hasn't offered it to yet, and shows the backgrounds other profiles have set. TikTok's servers may still refuse to save one for such an account. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_modified.name: Region spoof
patches_modified.description: Makes TikTok's region and time zone match the country you set for SIM spoof. It changes every region check, sign-in included, and its store region switch is experimental, so it isn't picked for you. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > Region spoof.
patches_modified.previous_description: Makes TikTok's region and time zone match the country you set for SIM spoof. It changes every region check, sign-in included, and its store region switch is experimental, so it isn't picked for you. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Region spoof.

patches_modified.name: Remember clear display
patches_modified.description: Keeps clear display, TikTok's mode that hides the buttons over a video, on as you swipe to the next video. It can also turn on by itself after a delay you pick, which starts off in the patch settings > Interface. When clear display ends, the Following stories bubble TikTok hid comes back too.
patches_modified.previous_description: Keeps clear display, TikTok's mode that hides the buttons over a video, on as you swipe to the next video. patches_modified.name: Remove LIVE extras
patches_modified.description: Removes the files for LIVE co-hosting, joining a LIVE as a guest, matches, games and gift effects, so the app gets about 3 MB smaller. The catch: in LIVEs, battle scores and guest names can go missing, and joining someone's LIVE by voice or video, co-hosting, games or animated gifts may stop working.

patches_modified.name: Remove avatar rings
patches_modified.description: Takes the story and LIVE rings off profile pictures, so tapping a picture opens the profile instead of a story or LIVE. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > Interface.
patches_modified.previous_description: Takes the story and LIVE rings off profile pictures, so tapping a picture opens the profile instead of a story or LIVE. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Remove card scanner assets
patches_modified.description: Removes TikTok's bundled payment card scanner files. Keeps the content credential and runtime libraries loaded by other features, including photo comments. Card scanning may stop working. Patch again without this to restore the removed files.

patches_modified.name: Remove creation tools
patches_modified.description: Removes the bundled face-detection model and effect-creation component. Keeps the shared photo and video editor needed by comment pictures. Face effects and effect creation may stop working. Patch again without this to restore the removed files.

patches_modified.name: Remove unused language packs
patches_modified.description: Removes the app languages you don't list in this patch's options, saving up to about 26 MB of storage. English is always kept. With no list it keeps them all. Only patching again brings removed ones back.

patches_modified.name: Repost diagnostics
patches_modified.description: With diagnostic logging on, notes when you repost a video and what TikTok answered, to help track down reposts that don't stick. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Resource and battery governor
patches_modified.description: Stops TikTok reading your phone's motion sensors, which it can use to identify your phone, and stops a background speed test that can use a lot of memory. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > App behavior.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops TikTok reading your phone's motion sensors, which it can use to identify your phone, and stops a background speed test that can use a lot of memory. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_modified.name: Resume videos after scrolling
patches_modified.description: When you scroll back to a video, it picks up where you left off instead of starting over. On by default. Turn it off in the patch settings > App behavior.
patches_modified.previous_description: When you scroll back to a video, it picks up where you left off instead of starting over. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_modified.name: Run beside the store app
patches_modified.description: Lets a renamed copy of TikTok, made with Morphe's Clone app patch, sign in while the regular TikTok stays installed. Pick it together with Clone app. Google and Facebook sign-in won't work in the copy, so use email or phone.

patches_modified.name: SIM spoof
patches_modified.description: Makes TikTok see the SIM country and carrier you choose. It may not change your region, since TikTok also goes by your internet connection and account. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > Region spoof.
patches_modified.previous_description: Makes TikTok see the SIM country and carrier you choose. It may not change your region, since TikTok also goes by your internet connection and account. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Region spoof.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Removes the tracking codes from TikTok links you share, so the link carries less about you. It can also swap tiktok.com for another site. On by default. Turn it off in the patch settings > App behavior.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes the tracking codes from TikTok links you share, so the link carries less about you. It can also swap tiktok.com for another site. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_modified.name: Settings
patches_modified.description: Adds the patch settings page to TikTok, at the top of Settings and privacy. Pressing and holding For You at the top of the feed opens it too. That's where you turn the features on and off. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds the Metra settings page to TikTok, at the top of Settings and privacy. Pressing and holding For You at the top of the feed opens it too. That's where you turn Metra's features on and off. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Share sheet tools
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide people, apps and buttons you don't use from the share sheet, add apps you do use, and copy a video's link with one press on Share. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > Share sheet.
patches_modified.previous_description: Lets you hide people, apps and buttons you don't use from the share sheet, add apps you do use, and copy a video's link with one press on Share. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Share sheet.

patches_modified.name: Show LIVE search
patches_modified.description: Adds TikTok's search button inside the LIVE section where TikTok supports it, so you can look for LIVEs. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > App behavior.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds TikTok's search button inside the LIVE section where TikTok supports it, so you can look for LIVEs. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_modified.name: Show author region

patches_modified.previous_description: Shows the country a video was posted from next to the creator's name. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Show commenter handle and region
patches_modified.description: Shows a commenter's @username in place of their display name and the country their account is set to after the comment's time. It can also give each commenter's name a color of its own. Each starts off. Turn them on in the patch settings > Comments and translation.

patches_modified.name: Show engagement rate
patches_modified.description: Shows how many people liked, commented on, shared or saved a video compared with how many watched it, next to the creator's name. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > Interface.
patches_modified.previous_description: Shows how many people liked, commented on, shared or saved a video compared with how many watched it, next to the creator's name. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Show exact counts

patches_modified.previous_description: Shows likes, comments and other counts as full numbers, like 1,234,567 instead of 1.2M. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Show follow status
patches_modified.description: Shows on a profile whether that person follows you back, and marks accounts in your follow lists that don't. On by default. Turn it off in the patch settings > App behavior. Optional local counts and appearance controls apply to your own profile.
patches_modified.previous_description: Shows on a profile whether that person follows you back, and marks accounts in your follow lists that don't. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > App behavior. Optional local counts and appearance controls apply to your own profile.

patches_modified.name: Show the progress bar
patches_modified.description: Shows the progress bar on videos where TikTok hides it, so you can see how long a video is and skip around. On by default. Turn it off in the patch settings > App behavior, where you can also show the time beside the bar or give it a bigger handle. A seek bar for video stories is there too.
patches_modified.previous_description: Shows the progress bar on videos where TikTok hides it, so you can see how long a video is and skip around. On by default. patches_modified.name: Show the progress bar thumbnail
patches_modified.description: Shows a small preview picture while you drag the progress bar, so you can find the part you want. On by default. Turn it off in the patch settings > App behavior.
patches_modified.previous_description: Shows a small preview picture while you drag the progress bar, so you can find the part you want. On by default. Turn it off in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_modified.name: Skip content warnings

patches_modified.previous_description: Plays videos without the warning screen you'd have to tap through first, and can hide the Check sources and Check your sources banners. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > Interface.

patches_modified.description: Skips TikTok's setup screens on a fresh install, like the interest picker and the swipe tutorial. Sign-in and age screens still show. Its switch is on once picked, since setup runs before you can reach settings. Turn it off in the patch settings > App behavior.

patches_modified.name: Skip the splash ad
patches_modified.description: Lets you stop the full-screen ad TikTok can show while it starts up. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > App behavior.
patches_modified.previous_description: Lets you stop the full-screen ad TikTok can show while it starts up. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_modified.name: Skip update checks
patches_modified.description: Lets you stop two background tasks TikTok uses to check for updates, one of them when your phone starts. Some in-app update prompts may stop. Play Store updates still work. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > App behavior.

patches_modified.description: Lets you stop TikTok's built-in AI engine from starting, so it doesn't get a copy of everything TikTok logs about your use. TikTok works as if the engine weren't there. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > App behavior.

patches_modified.previous_description: Stops a video at its end instead of playing it again. Starts off. Turn it on in Metra settings > App behavior.

patches_modified.name: Story controls
patches_modified.description: Lets a story replay when it ends instead of moving on, and keeps a photo story on screen until you tap or swipe. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > App behavior.

patches_modified.name: Trust user certificates
patches_modified.description: Lets TikTok trust security certificates you install yourself, so a tool like mitmproxy can show what the app sends. The risk: anyone who gets a certificate onto your phone can read TikTok's traffic too. Use it only on a test phone.

patches_modified.name: Turn off haptics
patches_modified.description: Stops the little vibrations TikTok makes when you tap or hold things. Your keyboard and your phone's own vibrations stay. Starts off. Turn it on in the patch settings > App behavior.

patches_modified.name: Record calls
